inputLatency.method: DOM input to first rAF after Unity feedback; presentation opportunity, not physical display latency

path: R, F9, right arrow 8s, R, pointer preview West field, F, M, Enter, Z, left arrow 8s, zoom out 6s, zoom in 5s, R, right arrow 4s. Capture automatically ends at 30s.
limits: One observed foreground run on M1 Max; actual monitor refresh approximately 120 Hz. Load was first navigation to this changed export in an existing Chrome session; cache not forcibly cleared and connection speed not measured. rAF denotes a presentation opportunity, not physical display latency. No controlled population benchmark.
